summary: Delivered-versus-scheduled state comes only from an order's delivery text, and a delivered event drops off the live events feed, so delivery questions are answered from order history and never inferred from event presence or order status.
reason: Fooda reports every placed order as checkout_complete and removes a day's event once it is delivered; trusting status or event presence listed scheduled orders as served meals and made a delivered day look like no order.
validated_outcome: Live order history returned status checkout_complete for delivered and upcoming orders alike; only the delivery text ('Delivered on ...' versus 'Delivering on ... between ...') differed.
